info.title: Moda Data API
info.description: Moda is the continual learning layer for AI agents. This read-only API provides tenant-scoped programmatic access to production trace analytics and related agent signals.

get.description: Reads the non-deduplicated raw span set for an OpenTelemetry trace_id or a Moda trace ID (the conversation_id field).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: OpenTelemetry trace_id or Moda trace ID (conversation_id).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Whether to interpret the ID as an OpenTelemetry trace_id, a Moda trace ID (conversation_id), or auto-detect.

parameters.name: include_raw
parameters.description: When set to 1, attach the raw event body to each ingest row.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum raw event rows to scan.

parameters.name: include_bodies
parameters.description: When set to 1, keep prompt/response/attribute bodies on each span (strings over 8 KB are truncated with a marker). Omitted by default.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Keyset cursor from a previous response's summary.next_cursor; returns the next page.

parameters.name: max_bytes
parameters.description: Page byte budget for clients with their own output limit; the page ends on an ingest-row boundary within it (a single larger row is still returned, with summary.over_byte_budget).

schema.description: Audit events and their raw span/trace context, when available.

401.description: The x-api-key header is missing, invalid, or revoked.

post.summary: Label a conversation for a custom signal
post.description: Records a Fits / Doesn't fit example for one conversation. Record-only: the summary is frozen and saved but no revision proposal is generated. Optional criteria / verdict provenance must agree with the label ((fail, accept) is fits, (pass, accept) is does_not_fit; a reject is never an example) or the request is a 400 label_mismatch. Limited to 10 requests per minute per API key.

schema.description: The recorded example (conversation, label, anchor, blurb).
